name: Grilled arowana
nameVi: cá hải tượng nướng muối ớt
summary: Arowana grilled with salt and chili, and also with satay over charcoal, served with green-chili salt and herbs.
origin: Củ Chi. The dish is recent there and describes the grilling.
howToEat: Season the fish with salt and satay, grill it over charcoal, and serve green-chili salt and herbs. It is also the salt-and-chili grill.
seoDescription: Arowana grilled with salt and chili, and also with satay and green-chili salt.
